defect_inventory.title: Near-Duplicate Lexical MinHash Single-Token Inversion False Merge
defect_inventory.root_cause: Lexical MinHash operates strictly on character n-shingles; in long passages, changing 10mg to 100mg or 'safe' to 'toxic' alters < 5% of shingles, producing estimated Jaccard >= 0.90 >= 0.80 and erroneously merging semantically contradictory records.
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Implemented Stage 3 SemanticSafetyGuard which normalizes numerical quantities into SI base units, evaluates polarity antonym sets, detects asymmetric negation particles, and verifies calendar dates before permitting record merges.
defect_inventory.residual_risk: Low; domain-specific non-SI units (e.g. apothecaries' weights) to be expanded in Phase 5.

defect_inventory.title: Scientific Academic Figure Caption Quarantined as Borderline Stopwords
defect_inventory.root_cause: Technical academic figure captions dominated by noun phrases have low stopword density (1 stopword), which triggered Quarantine Rule A (stopword_count in (1, 2) and word_count >= 12).
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Added academic caption recognition rule (_CAPTION_PATTERN) matching formal figure/table headings with clean Latin script and sufficient length, accepting them as FLUENT_ACADEMIC_CAPTION.

defect_inventory.title: Germanic Cognate Text Blindly Rejected Instead of Quarantined
defect_inventory.reproducibility: 100% reproducible on v3_test_de_002 ('Es ist in der Tat...')
defect_inventory.root_cause: QualityFilter rejected text with >= 15 words and only 1 stopword as NO_ENGLISH_STOPWORDS at step 1 before the text could ever reach the intended Quarantine Rule A.
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Intercepted NO_ENGLISH_STOPWORDS rejections when text is clean Latin prose containing standard Germanic/Dutch cognates (_GERMANIC_COGNATES), correctly routing them to QUARANTINE.

defect_inventory.title: Whitespace-Only Text Inconsistently Categorized as Non-Empty
defect_inventory.reproducibility: 100% reproducible on strings containing only whitespace characters
defect_inventory.root_cause: char_length was checked before trimming, causing strings of 60 spaces to fail on TOO_SHORT_WORDS instead of EMPTY_TEXT.
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Harden empty text check to evaluate char_length == 0 or not normalized_text.strip().

defect_inventory.title: Missing Type Validation on Non-String Inputs in Corpus Processors
defect_inventory.root_cause: Missing explicit isinstance(text, str) validation in TextNormalizer and QualityFilter.
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Added defensive isinstance(text, str) checks raising TypeError.

defect_inventory.title: Resource Leak & Corrupted Temp DB Risk on Interrupted Lexicon Build
defect_inventory.reproducibility: Reproducible on unhandled exception during batch build in SqliteLexiconBuilder
defect_inventory.root_cause: Connection was not closed and temporary .tmp.sqlite file was not unlinked on error.
defect_inventory.fix_summary: Wrapped build lifecycle in try...finally ensuring connection close and temp DB unlinking.
